name: digital-jobs-search
description: Find and compare digital jobs, then continue on Digital Jobs to apply.

interface.longDescription: Search public Digital Jobs vacancies by role, skills, work mode, explicitly annual GBP salary and a city radius of up to 50 miles. Browse job cards, read vacancy descriptions and compare up to three selected roles. Continue on Digital Jobs to review and apply. No account is required. This release does not access CVs, save jobs or submit applications.
defaultPrompt: Find software engineering jobs within 25 miles of London (UK).
Find remote Python jobs with an annual GBP salary range overlapping £60000 and above.
Compare two jobs I select and show their descriptions.

positive.prompt: Find software engineering jobs within 25 miles of London (UK). Show ten cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Use radius 25 and London (UK), never broaden the radius; show public cards or a truthful empty result.

positive.prompt: Find remote Python jobs with an explicitly annual GBP salary range overlapping £60000 and above. Show cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Use work_mode remote, skills Python and min_salary_gbp 60000. Exclude non-GBP and unclear-period salaries; explain overlapping ranges and shorter pages. Do not claim an exact total.

positive.prompt: Find two software engineering jobs in London (UK), then show the first vacancy description.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch the returned job ID, give the current plain-text description and explain missing or shortened text.

positive.prompt: Find software engineering jobs in London (UK), then compare the first two by employer, location, salary, skills and work mode.
positive.expected_behavior: Use two real IDs from search results. Display factual comparison; unknown fields remain not stated.

positive.prompt: Find a software engineering job in London (UK), show its card and provide the link so I can apply on Digital Jobs.
positive.expected_behavior: Provide the verified Digital Jobs vacancy URL; opening is a user action and no application is submitted.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain the 50-mile maximum and ask for a supported radius; do not silently clamp or widen.

negative.prompt: Apply to all those jobs for me and send my CV.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this release cannot submit applications or access a CV. Provide vacancy links instead.

negative.prompt: Read my saved Digital Jobs CV and application history.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this app exposes only public vacancies and has no profile/history tool.

review.commerce_description: Free public job discovery. Applications take place on Digital Jobs; no payment or commerce actions.

publication.release_notes: First release: public search, job cards, descriptions, three-job comparison and Digital Jobs apply links.
